text:
Ana: quick question — for customer-facing audit events should we use present-tense verbs (e.g. `user.create`) or past-tense (e.g. `user.created`)? want to lock a convention before we publish the event catalog.
Jasper: strong +1 for verb-first present-tense for action events we expose in APIs: `create_user` / `team.invite_sent` style. easier to parse and to build routing rules against.
Sam: product perspective: activity feeds typically show past-tense to humans. we could expose a canonical machine-readable name and then render human-facing strings in the UI. need mapping rules so customers don't get surprised.
Ollie: from the schema/linting side i'd prefer splitting intent and rendering: keep `event.verb = "create|delete|update"`, `event.object = "user|team"`, and `event.name = "svc.team.invite"` as the dotted canonical id. that gives us deterministic programmatic behavior.
Ana: we also have backwards-compat issues — a bunch of existing audits are `user.created` and `key.rotated`. how disruptive is a breaking rename?
Jasper: don't break customers. plan: introduce canonical names + an `aliases` array on the event manifest. example: `{"name":"svc.user.create","aliases":["user.created","user.create_v1"]}`. deprecate aliases after N months.
Sam: agree. product will own the customer-facing migration messaging. need examples, a migration snippet, and a FAQ for audit log consumers.
Ollie: i'll add validation rules to `event-lint` so new events must include `name`, `verb`, `object`, `version`, and optionally `aliases`. also add an automated check that `aliases` doesn't collide across services.
Kevin-bot: deploy note: schema v3 (adds `verb`/`object`/`aliases`) targeted for staging rollout 2026-05-01, prod 2026-06-15. see https://redwood-internal/rpm/SEC-4237 for rollout plan.
Sam: customer-facing examples should show both canonical and rendered forms. e.g. `event.name = "svc.key.rotate"` -> UI: "Key rotated". we should standardize capitalization rules for render layer.
Ana: quick sketch of the recommended canonical shape (for the docs):
```json
{
  "name": "svc.user.create",
  "verb": "create",
  "object": "user",
  "version": "v3",
  "aliases": ["user.created", "user.create_v1"],
  "meta": {"initiator": "user|system|api"}
}
```
Ollie: minor nit: `meta` will be freeform and causes linter headaches. suggest we enumerate a small set of canonical meta keys (initiator, actor_id, ip, request_id) and allow freeform under `meta.extra`.
Jasper: agreed. also call out which fields are PII and must be redacted by default in customer-facing streams. key rotation events should never include raw key material obviously.
Ana: OK action items: 1) draft mapping doc + alias table (Ana), 2) schema PR with `aliases` and linter changes (Ollie), 3) migration/messaging plan for customers (Sam), 4) alias ownership + deprecation policy (Jasper). please ack ownership and estimate timelines.
Jasper: I can own alias policy, will put up a short RFC by Wed.
Sam: i'll draft customer messaging + examples, aiming for end of week.
Ollie: i'll open the linter PR tomorrow and add collison checks.
Ana: i'll compile current event list and start the alias table today.
Kevin-bot: created ticket SEC-4237, linked: https://redwood-internal/SEC-4237.
Ana: thanks everyone — we'll sync again after RFCs land. :thumbsup:
